verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an agentic IDE, but the evidence pack never documents any scheduler, cron, or recurring-trigger capability. The claim that the agent can "orchestrate complex multi-step workflows" describes one-off, on-demand runs, not a recurring schedule. Skills, slash commands and parallel agents are adjacent features, not scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
